text: Democracy Now!•September 9, 2026“Focus Is on Affordability”: Cindy Holscher, Kansas Dem Nominee for Gov, on Data Center Fight & MoreSEN. HOLSCHER: So, what we’ve seen, too, is, again, this affordability crisis. As Kansas was looking at these issues and the Legislature was seeing what was going on, their response has been continued giveaways to billionaires and corporations, which leaves regular people behind. And so, when you hear people say, “The system’s being rigged against us,” yes, because, again, we’ve seen this just replaying of big giveaways, tax breaks for the wealthy, and, again, leaving regular folks behind.

Press Release•September 17, 2026Ks-Gov: No-Show Masterson Says No To More Debates After Losing The First OneDays after a disastrous appearance at the State Fair debate hosted by WIBW Radio, Republican nominee for governor Ty Masterson has rejected future debates against Senator Cindy Holscher. The Holscher campaign had previously accepted debate invitations by Gray Media and Nexstar for September 24 and October 1 debates, respectively. Gray Media stations include KCTV (Kansas City), KWCH (Wichita), and WIBW (Topeka). The Nexstar debate would run on six television stations covering 95% of the state. Masterson turned down both invitations.

Press Release•September 18, 2026Masterson Confirms: No More DebatesRepublican nominee for governor Ty Masterson is refusing to debate Senator Holscher again. His spokesperson confirmed to the Kansas Reflector that Masterson has “no plans to accept any further debates.” Masterson’s retreat comes less than a week after the two faced off at the Kansas State Fair, where Holscher hammered him over his 20-year record in the legislature and six years running the Senate.

Press Release•September 22, 2026Holscher Launches Statewide “Common Sense and Lower Costs Tour”Today, Senator Cindy Holscher announced the launch of her statewide Common Sense and Lower Costs Tour, kicking off Saturday, September 26, in Marysville. Over the next two weeks, Senator Cindy Holscher will travel the state, with at least 16 stops planned, to hear directly from Kansans and share her plan to lower costs for working families. The tour spends its first week in eastern Kansas before heading west for week two.

Press Release•September 23, 2026Holscher Campaign Launches “Republicans For Cindy”Today, Senator Cindy Holscher announced Republicans for Cindy, a coalition of twenty-one current and former Republican elected officials supporting her campaign for governor. Many served alongside both Holscher and Masterson and saw firsthand how she worked across party lines to deliver for Kansas families. Throughout her time in the legislature, Holscher has brought Republicans, Independents, and Democrats together around practical and pragmatic solutions. That record began in her first term in the Kansas House, when she co-founded a bipartisan coalition that ended the Brownback tax experiment and restored stability to the state budget.

Press Release•September 29, 2026Holscher launches new webisode on data centers with lifelong RepublicansIn a new video today, Democratic nominee for governor Cindy Holscher is highlighting the Marple family, who have raised serious concerns about a proposed 10-building data center complex threatening their family farm. The Marples are lifelong Republicans, but they are supporting Cindy Holscher because she’s the only candidate for governor taking data center concerns seriously.

Press Release•September 30, 2026Cindy Holscher Launches New Television Ad Highlighting Need for Firm Guardrails on Data CentersToday, Democratic nominee for governor Cindy Holscher launched her newest television ad, “Sunflowers,” highlighting the need for firm guardrails around new data center development in Kansas. The ad will air statewide on broadcast, cable, and digital platforms starting today.
